pages.text: The $(l)Sloop$(): one mast, two cannons, a crew of up to two. Small and nimble, quick to turn and to heave her anchor.
The $(l)Brigantine$(): two masts, four cannons, a crew of up to three, and a brig. The fastest ship of all with the wind on her beam, but she sinks the quickest: everything below is on one deck.

The $(l)Galleon$(): three masts, eight cannons on her gun deck, a crew of up to four, and a brig. Fastest running downwind, but slow to turn: she needs her whole crew. Hardest to sink, until the water reaches her gun deck.
